cn_title: 《GTA Online》赌场玩法在澳大利亚突然禁用
subtitle: 赌场熄灯

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has unexpectedly blocked in-game gambling features in GTA Online for players accessing the game from Australia. Australians are no longer able to activate gambling mini-games in GTA Online’s Diamond Casino, including blackjack, slots, poker, roulette, or the Inside Track horse racing mode. The free-to-spin lucky wheel is also disabled.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar意外封锁了澳大利亚玩家在《GTA Online》中使用的游戏内赌博功能。澳大利亚玩家已无法启动《GTA Online》钻石赌场中的赌博小游戏，包括二十一点、老虎机、扑克、轮盘赌和Inside Track赛马模式；可免费转动的幸运转盘也被停用。

paragraphs.en: These minigames were previously operating in Australia for the last seven years, since the establishment of the casino location in GTA Online in The Diamond Casino & Resort update on July 23, 2019. Other functionality and missions involving the casino remain intact and playable.
paragraphs.cn: 自2019年7月23日《GTA Online》通过The Diamond Casino & Resort更新加入赌场场所以来，这些小游戏已在澳大利亚运行了七年。其他与赌场有关的功能和任务仍完整保留，玩家也仍可游玩。

paragraphs.en: The sudden block subsequently comes as a curious move in July 2026, several months after the March introduction of the country's new online safety code that forced companies to introduce age verification mechanics as a barrier between minors and certain adult content, and almost two years after new mandatory minimum classifications for gambling-like content in video games were introduced in September 2024.
paragraphs.cn: 这一突然封锁发生在2026年7月，颇令人费解。几个月前的3月，该国推出新的网络安全规范，要求公司引入年龄验证机制，将未成年人隔离在部分成人内容之外；而在近两年前的2024年9月，针对电子游戏中类似赌博内容的强制最低分级标准也已出台。

paragraphs.en: For context, the new guidelines established that any video games containing simulated gambling, such as casino games, must be classified R18+ – which legally restricts them to adults. This would include “[v]ideo games that have interactive activities such as slot machine simulators, roulette wheels or other age-restricted gambling or betting services as part of a broader game.” The guidelines give an example of an RPG “which features a slot machine that players can interact and play with.” However, GTA Online is already rated R18+ in Australia – indeed, Grand Theft Auto V was rated R18+ in Australia upon its 2013 release on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. On paper, the movement of the classification guideline goalposts represents no net change in rating for GTA Online. As such, it’s unclear what suddenly prompted the change this week.
paragraphs.cn: 作为背景，新指南规定，凡包含模拟赌博内容的电子游戏，例如赌场游戏，均须评为R18+，即法律上只限成年人接触。这包括「在更大型游戏中含有老虎机模拟器、轮盘或其他受年龄限制的赌博或下注服务等互动活动的电子游戏」。指南举例称，一款RPG「含有玩家可以互动并游玩的老虎机」。不过，《GTA Online》在澳大利亚本就获评R18+；事实上，《GTA5》在2013年登陆PS3和XBOX 360时，便已在澳大利亚获评R18+。从纸面上看，分级指南门槛的变动并未改变《GTA Online》的评级。因此，目前仍不清楚究竟是什么促成了本周的突变。

paragraphs.en: IGN has requested clarification from Rockstar.

At least for now, Australia has joined a surprisingly long list of around 50 countries where GTA Online’s casino betting minigames are not functional , including Portugal, Poland, Argentina, Greece, Luxembourg, South Africa, South Korea, China, Malta, and many more.
paragraphs.cn: 至少目前，澳大利亚已加入一个出人意料地漫长的名单：约50个国家和地区的《GTA Online》赌场下注小游戏无法使用，其中包括葡萄牙、波兰、阿根廷、希腊、卢森堡、南非、韩国、中国、马耳他等。

paragraphs.en: Online casino gaming (including slots and casino table games like roulette and blackjack) is actually illegal in Australia, and has been for the last quarter of a century under the Interactive Gambling Act 2001 (Cth). Of course, GTA Online’s Diamond Casino is not an actual casino, and certainly wouldn’t appear to be the sort of thing this legislation is intended to apply to. In GTA Online, players purchase casino chips using in-game currency that is earned by playing the game and completing tasks and missions. It’s true that GTA Online allows players to purchase lump sums of in-game currency using real money, but currency bought with real money was treated as distinct and could not be used to purchase casino chips. GTA Online also features no functionality to turn currency won in-game into real-world money.
paragraphs.cn: 根据《2001年互动赌博法》(联邦)，线上赌场游戏——包括老虎机，以及轮盘赌和二十一点等赌场桌面游戏——实际上在澳大利亚违法，且这一规定已实行25年。当然，《GTA Online》的钻石赌场并非真正的赌场，看起来也显然不是该法意图规制的对象。在《GTA Online》中，玩家用通过游玩游戏、完成任务和差事赚取的游戏内货币购买赌场筹码。诚然，《GTA Online》允许玩家用真实货币购买大额游戏内货币，但用真钱购买的货币被视为独立类别，不能用于购买赌场筹码。《GTA Online》也没有把游戏内赢得的货币兑换成现实货币的功能。

paragraphs.en: Regardless of the broader conversation around Australia’s otherwise world-leading addiction to gambling, a high-profile case like GTA Online is likely to generate considerable cynicism considering it’s not the real thing. In per capita terms, Australians are the world’s biggest actual gamblers, with losses equivalent to over $1,500 per adult every year.
paragraphs.cn: 抛开澳大利亚在赌博成瘾方面居世界前列这一更广泛的话题不谈，像《GTA Online》这样的高知名度案例很可能招致相当多的质疑，因为它并非真正的赌博。从人均计算，澳大利亚人是全球实际赌博损失最高的人群，每名成年人每年的损失相当于超过1,500美元(约合人民币1万元)。

paragraphs.en: Luke is a Senior Editor on the IGN reviews team. You can track him down on Bluesky @mrlukereilly to ask him things about stuff.
paragraphs.cn: Luke是IGN评测团队的高级编辑。你可以在Bluesky上通过@mrlukereilly找到他，向他提问。

opus_summary: Rockstar已在澳大利亚禁用《GTA Online》钻石赌场的多种赌博小游戏与幸运转盘。该作仍为R18+，赌场相关任务可玩；官方尚未解释原因，澳大利亚也加入约50个禁用国家和地区之列。
